# QuickCalc

> Elegant, Science-Backed Calculator Suite for your health, finance, and educational calculation needs.

## Tools
- [BMI Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/bmi-calculator): Calculate your body mass index (BMI) instantly. Analyze clinical weight ranges with a live horizontal gauge.
- [Calorie Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/calorie-calculator): Calculate your BMR and TDEE using the modern Mifflin-St Jeor formula. Get tailored calorie targets for losing, maintaining, and gaining weight.
- [Water Intake Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/water-intake-calculator): Calculate your ideal daily hydration requirements based on your body weight, activity level, and climate.
- [Pace Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/pace-calculator): Calculate running pace, time, or distance with our 3-in-1 calculator. View live km/mile side-by-side conversions and instant race time predictions.
- [Due Date Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/due-date-calculator): Estimate your baby's arrival date, trace gestational milestones, and follow your week-by-week trimester timeline.
- [Shoe Size Converter](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/shoe-size-converter): Convert shoe sizes instantly between US, UK, EU, and Japan systems simultaneously with built-in brand variance guidance.
- [Paper & Fabric Size Converter](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/paper-fabric-size-converter): Convert standard print paper formats and fabric lengths simultaneously with two dedicated, live-updating modes.
- [JSON & CSV Converter](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/json-csv-converter): Convert JSON to CSV and CSV back to nested JSON structures securely in browser memory. 100% private client-side translation.
- [Regex Tester](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/regex-tester): Test and debug regular expressions instantly with live colored highlighting and plain-language pattern explanations.
- [Sleep Cycle Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/sleep-cycle-calculator): Optimize your bedtime and waking schedule using 90-minute sleep cycles to wake up refreshed and energetic.
- [GPA Converter](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/gpa-converter): Convert international grades and percentages from US, UK, Canada, India, and Pakistan to the standard 4.0 scale.
- [Loan / EMI Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/loan-calculator): Calculate monthly installments, interest payments, and view a comprehensive year-by-year amortization schedule.
- [Color Palette Generator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/color-palette-generator): Extract up to 8 beautiful dominant colors from any image. Analyze WCAG contrast compliance and export custom CSS/Tailwind configurations.
- [Word & Character Counter](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/word-character-counter): Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and estimated reading times. Get live warning notifications for popular social post limits.
- [Secure Password Generator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/password-generator): Generate cryptographically secure passwords locally with precise entropy calculations and customizable pools.
- [Timezone Meeting Planner](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/timezone-meeting-planner): Schedule meetings across multiple timezones safely using geographical database options and overlap calculations.
- [Tip Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/tip-calculator): Calculate custom tipping values instantly, split bills evenly between groups, and copy detailed breakdowns locally.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/percentage-calculator): Calculate percentage changes, fractions, savings, discount values, and reverse percentages instantly with dynamic formulas.
- [Group Expense Splitter](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/group-expense-splitter): Split group bills, meals, and trip expenses unevenly. Allocate specific items and distribute tax/tip proportionally.
- [Age Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/age-calculator): Find your exact chronological age in years, months, and days. Uncover your zodiac traits, generational era, countdown to your next birthday, and share your personalized age card!
- [Currency Converter](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/currency-converter): Convert 35+ major world currencies instantly with live exchange rates. Compare ranges and copy formatted results with backlinks.
- [Budget Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/budget-calculator): Split your income using the 50/30/20 rule with customizable percentages and a real-spending comparison.
- [Zakat Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/zakat-calculator): Calculate your Zakat cleanly with a category-by-category breakdown. Support for custom gold/silver rates and Nisab standard selector.
- [Salary Take-Home Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/salary-take-home-calculator): Calculate your estimated net take-home salary after income taxes & payroll deductions in the US, Canada, and Pakistan side-by-side.
- [Pregnancy Weight Gain Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/pregnancy-weight-gain-calculator): Calculate personalized healthy pregnancy weight gain ranges week-by-week based on pre-pregnancy Body Mass Index and gestational timing.
- [Habit Cost Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/habit-cost-calculator): Calculate the combined compounding time and money cost of daily recurring habits over years, decades, and by retirement.
- [Discount Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/discount-calculator): Calculate sale prices with single or stacked discounts, visual step-by-step math, and reverse pre-discount calculations instantly.
- [Inflation Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/inflation-calculator): Calculate historical inflation and buying power changes in the US, Canada, and Pakistan. Compare money value then vs now instantly.
- [Savings Growth Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/savings-growth-calculator): Calculate your compound interest earnings over time with regular monthly or yearly contributions. Track total contributed vs interest.
- [Travel Time & Fuel Cost Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/travel-time-fuel-calculator): Calculate speed, distance, time, flight cruising durations, and estimated vehicle trip fuel costs in real-time.
